title: Essay pages: choose the reading structure
question: Sustained reading, every essay's text and links unchanged. Lock one structure, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: Chapters with a contents rail
options.thesis: A sticky rail lists the essay's sections and a quiet dotted line tracks your progress beside the column.
materials: canary progress line in the margin
options.viewport: Title block over the column; at left, 'In this essay' with the four sections, the current one ticked in canary.
options.risk: One essay has no sections, so the rail must collapse cleanly; the progress line must never touch the text.

options.label: The quiet column
options.thesis: Nothing but the essay: one centered column, the canary resting on the byline rule.
options.viewport: Back link, a big two-line title, description, and byline centered; the essay begins on a white surface below.
options.risk: Plainest option; its quality rests entirely on type scale, measure, and rhythm.

options.label: A small opening plate
options.thesis: Each essay opens with its own quiet miniature beside the title, then the column takes over.
options.viewport: Title, description, and byline left; a small vignette of the essay's idea right; the column below.
options.risk: Ten new plates to art-direct, and spectacle creeping into a reading page if the vignettes get loud.
